name: Ryoujoku Gekijou "Joshikousei Kyousei Baishun/Goukan Apart"
original_name: 凌辱劇場　「女子校生強制売春／強姦アパート」
source:
Forced High School Girl Prostitution is the second fully voiced visual novel set in the same apartment.

Our 3 voice actresses play a variety of characters with very different personalities including violated high school girls, college girls, and wives.

This production is not a choose your own adventure game -- it's merely set up for you to enjoy the story. With the Chapter function, you can choose to play at your favorite points.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ040384.html]DLsite English[/url]]
